name: Entity Information
description: Provides an information tab for entities that can be filled with content from custom plugins.
project_description: Entity Information adds an extra 'Information' local-task tab to entities (e.g. /node/{node}/information). The tab renders one or more collapsible detail blocks, each supplied by an EntityInformation plugin, and a settings form lets a site enable or disable the available plugins. Two example plugins ship with the module (path aliases and menu links for nodes). Developers extend it by writing their own EntityInformation plugins that declare the entity-type/bundle combinations they target and build a render array for a given entity.
